description: Validates inbound FHIR JSON against a FHIR server's $validate operation and forwards it unchanged only on a clean pass. Fails closed: an invalid resource, a timeout, an HTTP error, a malformed response, or a profile the server cannot resolve all stop the node so nothing unvalidated is forwarded. Validation is remote - the FHIR server is the authority; a 200 is not treated as a pass, the returned OperationOutcome decides. The resource type is read from the resource itself, so one node validates Patient, Observation, Encounter and others. TLS verification is always on and the request timeout is an internal default; neither is exposed. Leave the server URL unset until an administrator selects an approved endpoint - the public HAPI server is a development example only and must not receive real patient data.

config.label: FHIR Server URL
config.description: The FHIR base URL whose $validate operation to call, with no trailing resource path. For synthetic development testing only: https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4. In production, use a PHI-approved endpoint - never send real patient data to the public server.

config.label: FHIR Profile
config.description: Optional. A profile canonical URL to validate against (for example a US Core profile). Leave empty to validate against the resource's base definition. The profile must be installed on the server; if it cannot be resolved the resource is not forwarded - there is no silent fall back to base validation.
